title: 3 Anime That Arguably Deserved Crunchyroll’s 2026 Best New Anime Award Over Gachiakuta
content: The Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 have officially concluded, revealing the Best New Anime of 2025. Gachiakuta , based on the manga by Kei Urana and produced by Bones Film, emerged as the winner.
author: ComicBook

title: Uchi no Otouto-domo ga Sumimasen Reveals New Trailer, Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content: Uchi no Otouto-domo ga Sumimasen ( Sorry About My Younger Brothers ) anime revealed a new trailer, the opening and ending theme songs, and additional cast members. The series is set to premiere on July 23, 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: Hana-Kimi Season 2 Reveals Trailer
content: Hana-Kimi Season 2 revealed a trailer on Saturday featuring the opening and ending theme songs. The sequel will begin on July 1, 2026. Omoinotake is singing both the opening and ending theme songs. Signal.MD animated the first season with Natsuki Takemura as director and Shigeru Ueda as the assistant director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Grand Blue Dreaming Anime Season 3 Announces Opening Song Artists
content: The official website for the television anime of Kenji Inoue and Kimitake Yoshioka 's Grand Blue Dreaming manga presented the key visual and opening theme song's artists for the third season on Sunday, to celebrate "Scuba Diving Day" in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Maebashi Witches Compilation Anime Film Reveals Title, Fall Opening
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Sunday the compilation film for the Maebashi Witches original television anime will open this fall. The company also revealed a teaser visual and the film's title: Gekijoban Maebashi Witches : Majo Minarai no Emoemories ( Maebashi Witches Emoemories: Blooming Witches ).
author: ANN
